test_commands.go: mkdir -p .quality && go test -race -coverpkg=./... -coverprofile=.quality/cover.out $(go list -f '{{if or .TestGoFiles .XTestGoFiles}}{{.ImportPath}}{{end}}' ./...) && total=$(go tool cover -func=.quality/cover.out | awk '/^total:/{sub(/%/,"",$NF); print $NF}') && echo "total coverage: ${total}% (min 50%)" && awk -v t="$total" 'BEGIN{exit !(t != "" && t+0 >= 50)}'
